thought.text: All infrastructure is running. Now restart the dev servers.

reasoning_content: Cleanup complete. All 10 infrastructure containers are running. Next, restart `just serve` in the background. The boards server was terminating immediately with exit code 0 — this might be a temporary build cache issue, or it might be because the first serve attempt was still building when the crash was detected. Let's try again and monitor.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export GITHUB_TOKEN="urbo-dev-token-not-consumed-by-build" && nohup just serve > /tmp/just-serve2.log 2>&1 &
echo "serve2 pid $!"; sleep 90; grep -aE "Building|Local:|ready|crashed|error|exited" /tmp/just-serve2.log | tail -8; pgrep -f "[s]erve.mjs" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo STOPPED

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export GITHUB_TOKEN=\"urbo-dev-token-not-consumed-by-build\" && nohup just serve > /tmp/just-serve2.log 2>&1 &\necho \"serve2 pid $!\"; sleep 90; grep -aE \"Building|Local:|ready|crashed|error|exited\" /tmp/just-serve2.log | tail -8; pgrep -f \"[s]erve.mjs\" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo STOPPED", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Restart just serve in background"}
